definitions.explanation: The criminal act of intentionally setting fire to a building or property. A serious crime in Japan, consistently among the top causes of fires.

examples.english: He was arrested on suspicion of arson.

notes: Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {放火|ほうか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to commit arson). Common collocations: ⟦{放火犯|ほうかはん}→放火犯：27045_houkahan⟧ (arsonist), {放火事件|ほうかじけん} (arson case), {連続放火|れんぞくほうか} (serial arson). Arson is one of the most heavily punished crimes in Japan, with penalties ranging up to life imprisonment or the death penalty under the Penal Code. In fire statistics, {放火|ほうか} and {放火|ほうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧ (suspected arson) are perennially among the leading causes of fire in Japan.
